evals.name: canvas-card-guide
evals.prompt: Write a normative visual appearance guide for the Item card on the canvas. Prefer prototype/ components when present; otherwise use fixtures/src/components/canvas/. Save the guide as item-card-visual.md. Cross-link related panel/shell docs even if those files do not exist yet. Do not invent UI that the fixtures do not describe. English.
evals.expected_output: Markdown normative guide for canvas card with Does not cover, Element|How tables, ASCII block order, states, checklist; no form field deep-dive; no layout math; source-of-truth cites prototype/ or fixture paths (not vN/prototype/).
assertions: Output file is markdown normative guide (not a code patch)
Contains an explicit Does not cover / Out of scope section
Contains at least one Element | How it should appear style table
Contains ASCII overview of block order
Documents empty or overflow states for members or title
Includes a quick visual checklist
Does not prescribe side-panel form field order as the main focus
Does not narrate React hooks or implementation details as the story

evals.name: panel-shell-guide
evals.prompt: Write a normative visual guide for the side panel SHELL only (chrome: width, header, scroll, visibility). Source of truth: fixtures/src/components/panel/DetailPanel.tsx and PanelHeader.tsx. Save as panel-shell.md. Explicitly keep per-selection form fields out of scope. English.
evals.expected_output: Shell-only appearance guide; excludes Item form fields; documents 480px, visibility states, fixed header + scroll content.
assertions: Output is a shell appearance guide, not a form field catalog
States fixed width 480px (or equivalent from fixture)
Documents visibility when no card is selected
Documents fixed header vs scrollable content
Has Does not cover pointing away from per-type form fields
Does not deep-document Identification/Members/Settings form blocks
Includes expected visual behavior table or equivalent
Includes quick visual checklist

evals.name: layout-near-miss
evals.prompt: I need documentation for how the canvas layout grid is calculated (gaps, snap, resize formulas). There is fixtures/docs/layout-canvas.md. Produce the right kind of documentation for this request. If a normative visual appearance guide is the wrong artifact, say so and produce or extend a technical layout doc instead — do not force a card/form visual guide.
evals.expected_output: Technical layout documentation or explicit refusal to write a visual appearance guide as the primary artifact; must not pretend layout math is a card/panel visual normative guide.
assertions: Does not present a card/form normative visual guide as the primary deliverable
Acknowledges the request is technical layout (grid/gaps/snap) rather than surface appearance
Either extends/writes layout technical content or clearly redirects to layout doc type
Does not invent Element|How appearance tables for Item card chrome as the answer
